preconditions.expression: isinstance(stdin, str) and 1 <= len(stdin) <= 10**5 and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: stdin is a non-empty string of length up to 10^5 containing only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The first line of stdout is the omeric string constructed by concatenating the longest palindromic suffix and longest palindromic prefix of stdin.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.splitlines()[1].split()) == len(omeric_string) and all(isinstance(int(freq), int) and freq >= 0 for freq in stdout.splitlines()[1].split())
postconditions.description: The second line of stdout contains space-separated integers representing the frequency of each prefix of the omeric string as a substring in the omeric string itself.

postconditions.expression: all(omeric_string.startswith(prefix) and (omeric_string.count(prefix) == int(freq)) for prefix, freq in zip([omeric_string[:i] for i in range(1, len(omeric_string)+1)], stdout.splitlines()[1].split()))
postconditions.description: For each prefix of the omeric string (from length 1 to full length), the corresponding frequency in the second line matches the number of times that prefix appears as a substring in the omeric string.
